description: This code-behind file manages the logic for the 'TheoryExam.aspx' page in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them to the user, managing session validation, and submitting user answers back to the database. It also includes navigation functions and a timer for the exam duration.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: The code-behind class for the ASP.NET 'TheoryExam.aspx' page, managing exam question loading, navigation, timer, and answer submission logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page: session validation, fetching questions from the database, and setting the exam timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the course name based on the given course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Stores the submitted answers into the database, updates course and queue tables, and navigates to the dashboard.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the timer display and handles the exam time expiration.
